units.utility_notes_package_cost: Water, sewer, gas, and trash will be billed based on the actual charges divided among the units. The formula for these charges factors in the unit's usage, number of occupants, and square footage of the apartment. The utilities will fluctuate each month/season. Internet will be a flat rate of $45 per unit per month. Building *estimates* for total cost including internet are: Studio - $110-$150, Conv - $130-$195, 1 Bed - $160-$230, 2 Bed - $200-$280 Electric (ComEd): Individually metered  Internet is 100mbps. Customer can upgrade and add cable for an additional cost

units.off_site_parking_options: Electric charging stations located at Coast and Aqua. Discounted parking available in the neighborhood. Check out Standard Parking's website: $160/mo at Village Market (Mariano's) garage. You can also request a quote for 165 N Field spots that are managed by Standard Parking. Also try Field Harbor Parking, http://www.fieldharbor.com/contact-us/.  Spots managed by The Building Group are $160/mo but they do require a 12 month lease.

units.special: $1000 24 hour look and lease on convertible move in by 6/30
units.parking_for_tours: Loading zone in front of either Tides or Shoreham with flashers on (let door staff know), or garage for either building, off of N Field.
units.hold_notes: Pricing typically stays the same within the 10 day hold window. Will sometimes hold vacant units for 14-21 days. Double check with building.
units.utility_notes_package_cost: Water, sewer, gas, and trash will be billed based on the actual charges divided among the units. The formula for these charges factors in the unit's usage, number of occupants, and square footage of the apartment. The utilities will fluctuate each month/season. Internet will be a flat rate of $45 per unit per month. Building *estimates* for total cost including internet are: Studio - $110-$150, Conv - $130-$195, 1 Bed - $160-$230, 2 Bed - $200-$280 Electric (ComEd): Individually metered Internet is 100mbps. Customer can upgrade and add cable for an additional cost
units.off_site_parking_options: Discounted parking available in the neighborhood. Check out Standard Parking's website: $160/mo at Village Market (Mariano's) garage. You can also request a quote for 165 N Field spots that are managed by Standard Parking. Also try Field Harbor Parking, http://www.fieldharbor.com/contact-us/.  Spots managed by The Building Group are $160/mo but they do require a 12 month lease.
units.pet_fee_notes: $650/1 dog, $750/2 dogs, $325/cat. $30 one time PetScreening per pet.

units.parking_for_tours: Loading zone in front of either Tides or Shoreham with flashers on (let door staff know), or garage for either building, off of N Field.
units.hold_notes: Pricing typically stays the same within the 10 day hold window. Will sometimes hold vacant units for 14-21 days. Double check with building.
units.utility_notes_package_cost: Water, sewer, gas, and trash will be billed based on the actual charges divided among the units. The formula for these charges factors in the unit's usage, number of occupants, and square footage of the apartment. The utilities will fluctuate each month/season. Internet will be a flat rate of $45 per unit per month. Building *estimates* for total cost including internet are: Studio - $110-$150, Conv - $130-$195, 1 Bed - $160-$230, 2 Bed - $200-$280 Electric (ComEd): Individually metered  Internet is 100mbps. Customer can upgrade and add cable for an additional cost
units.utilities_notes: *one-time garage transponder fee is $75. No EV charging onsite at Tides or Shoreham, but residents can check monthly rates at these garages that are nearby: Aqua, Aon Center, Millennium Park using this link, https://parking.com/chicago/
units.off_site_parking_options: Electric charging stations located at Coast and Aqua. Discounted parking available in the neighborhood. Check out Standard Parking's website: $160/mo at Village Market (Mariano's) garage. You can also request a quote for 165 N Field spots that are managed by Standard Parking. Also try Field Harbor Parking, http://www.fieldharbor.com/contact-us/.  Spots managed by The Building Group are $160/mo but they do require a 12 month lease.
units.pet_fee_notes: $650/1 dog, $750/2 dogs, $325/cat. $30 one time PetScreening per pet.

The formula for these charges factors in the unit's usage, number of occupants, and square footage of the apartment. The utilities will fluctuate each month/season. Internet will be a flat rate of $45 per unit per month. Building *estimates* for total cost including internet are: Studio - $110-$150, Conv - $130-$195, 1 Bed - $160-$230, 2 Bed - $200-$280 Electric (ComEd): Individually metered  Internet is 100mbps. Check out Standard Parking's website: $160/mo at Village Market (Mariano's) garage. You can also request a quote for 165 N Field spots that are managed by Standard Parking. Also try Field Harbor Parking, http://www.fieldharbor.com/contact-us/.  Spots managed by The Building Group are $160/mo but they do require a 12 month lease.

Building *estimates* for total cost including internet are: Studio - $110-$150, Conv - $130-$195, 1 Bed - $160-$230, 2 Bed - $200-$280 Electric (ComEd): Individually metered  Internet is 100mbps. Customer can upgrade and add cable for an additional cost

units.hold_notes: Pricing typically stays the same within the 10 day hold window. Will sometimes hold vacant units for 14-21 days. Double check with building.
units.utility_notes_package_cost: Water, sewer, gas, and trash will be billed based on the actual charges divided among the units. The formula for these charges factors in the unit's usage, number of occupants, and square footage of the apartment. The utilities will fluctuate each month/season. Internet will be a flat rate of $45 per unit per month. Building *estimates* for total cost including internet are: Studio - $110-$150, Conv - $130-$195, 1 Bed - $160-$230, 2 Bed - $200-$280 Electric (ComEd): Individually metered  Internet is 100mbps. Customer can upgrade and add cable for an additional cost
units.utilities_notes: *one-time garage transponder fee is $75. No EV charging onsite at Tides or Shoreham, but residents can check monthly rates at these garages that are nearby: Aqua, Aon Center, Millennium Park using this link, https://parking.com/chicago/
units.off_site_parking_options: Electric charging stations located at Coast and Aqua. Discounted parking available in the neighborhood. Check out Standard Parking's website: $160/mo at Village Market (Mariano's) garage. You can also request a quote for 165 N Field spots that are managed by Standard Parking. Also try Field Harbor Parking, http://www.fieldharbor.com/contact-us/.  Spots managed by The Building Group are $160/mo but they do require a 12 month lease.
units.pet_fee_notes: $650/1 dog, $750/2 dogs, $325/cat. $30 one time PetScreening per pet.
